hypotheses.title: Subindustry-Neutralized Intermediate Put-Call Skew (180d Put vs 90d Call)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 221, market-neutralized long-tenor options skew achieved 8 PASS (Sharpe 1.61, Fitness 1.62, Turnover 15.30%). This alpha adapts the structural skew mechanism to intermediate tenors (6-month put vs 3-month call) and neutralizes by subindustry. Subindustry neutralization zeroes out broad market volatility shifts and compares each equity's put-call tail premium against its direct peer group. This isolates pure idiosyncratic volatility mispricing while guaranteeing low correlation with market-wide skew signals.
confounders: Subindustry-wide regulatory or earnings shocks that alter peer group skew uniformly
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if intermediate put-call skew fails to predict peer-relative stock performance.

hypotheses.title: Subindustry Put Term Structure Inversion Reversion (360d Put vs 90d Put)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Under normal market conditions, options implied volatility trades in contango (longer maturities trade at higher IV than shorter maturities). When front-month put IV spikes relative to 1-year put IV (put_90 > put_360), the put curve inverts into backwardation, reflecting acute near-term institutional panic hedging. Shorting this inversion within each subindustry harvests the volatility term structure roll-down premium as panic subsides and the curve flattens back to normal.
confounders: Persistent distress regimes where short-term corporate default risk remains elevated for multiple quarters
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if put term structure backwardation persists indefinitely without mean-reverting.

hypotheses.title: Subindustry Call Term Structure Contango Momentum (360d Call vs 90d Call)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Institutional investors pay a premium for long-dated call options (implied_volatility_call_360) over short-dated calls (implied_volatility_call_90) when they possess high conviction in sustained multi-quarter earnings expansion. Going long equities with the steepest call contango relative to their subindustry peers captures positive upside optionality and institutional flow momentum with minimal turnover (~14%).
confounders: Overoptimistic institutional consensus that fails to materialize in realized earnings
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high call term structure slope reflects unhedged speculative retail buying rather than institutional flow.
